name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
labels: [enhancement] 
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

What problem does this feature solve? Be specific about who benefits and
under what conditions (e.g. "per-user verification volume is high, and the
~21B-instruction verify cost makes the UX unacceptable").

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to happen, at the level the repo would need (canister
API change, circuit change, new tooling).

## Alternatives

What other approaches you considered or why the current path exists.

## Notes on safety / verification

Anything security-relevant this change touches (access control, crypto,
state serialization, upgrade behavior), and how you would verify it.
